title: Whimsical Animations Course Open House
content:
Welcome to 🏡

I've selected a handful of lessons from across the course and made them public for a couple of days, so that you can get a sense of my teaching style and decide whether this course is right for you or not.

Thanks so much for taking the time to check it out! I hope you find this content useful, regardless of whether or not you decide to enroll in the course.

You can browse through the included lessons using the lesson navigation on the left. Or, you can go through them one by one using the “Next Up” link below.

You can browse through the included lessons by clicking the Hamburger button in the top left. Or, you can go through them one by one using the “Next Up” link below.
